title: Knowledge Wiki family closure
purpose: Close the frozen feature/knowledge-wiki-A through E family into one reviewable, public-safe candidate without creating parallel authorities or erasing donor strengths.

criteria.title: One architecture and complete donor ledger
Archive observations are reconciled without false equivalence
Distinct reader pathways exist and are discoverable
Jamie is visible without sole-credit or causality inflation
Implementation, adoption, handoff, and continuity remain distinct
Campaign and civic outcomes retain institutional boundaries
Decision records preserve actors, constraints, unknowns, and anti-claims
Public-safety and selective-projection boundaries remain intact
Adversarial coverage and review packets are explicit
The exact candidate is bound while human gates remain open

human_only_gates: Jamie final content and voice review
collaborator correction or consent where required
